items.q: we was kind of raised up -- we grew up together. We come up as youngsters

ctx.x: He mentioned -- he said who we were, each one. It was about -- approximately about 30 or 20 guys, you know. Different ages. And we'd come up and revie, you know. And Like an (unintelligible) or so, you know, and stay at attention, you see, because eventually we were going to go, you understand, after the passions, emotions like they say. But we said -- we said happy reawakening, see. Tap dancer's dream.
Let's go on now, Chuck, to some of the other real powerhouses of tap dancing during that era, people like Rhythm Red, what he was doing.

Oh, John. Yeah, John Rhythm Red Shivers. Yeah. Well, see he was -- see, he was known as Debut, you know, Debut John. That's what I used to call him. And when he was -- we was kind of raised up -- we grew up together. We come up as youngsters (unintelligible) -- around the fraternity uptown, you know.
